$comment: Single source of truth for the self-hosted fonts. Read by build-fonts.py (never written by it), by scripts/fonts/__tests__/fonts.test.ts and by src/lib/fonts.ts. See scripts/fonts/README.md.

required.$comment: Characters every output of a range must map by itself. The latin file of a family must render a French, Dutch, German or Spanish page alone.

exceptions.U+202F: No thin space in the Fraunces source, and its U+00A0 is a full 0.205 em space: aliasing would widen it. U+202F is inkless, so Inter (next in --font-display) supplies the correct 0.18 em width.
exceptions.U+2190: Not drawn by the Fraunces source; inkless or symbolic, it falls back to Inter, next in --font-display.
